codex_structured_result.summary: Closed R2-S-01 for slice 021B by adding an explicit Windows/Cygwin guard at the start of `cmd_keygen()` so unsupported platforms fail before reaching `_write_bytes`, preserving the existing non-zero `O_NOFOLLOW` behavior on POSIX. Added a scoped regression test that patches `sys.platform` to `win32` and asserts the guard raises `SystemExit`, with a skip on actual Windows runners, and updated `pyproject.toml` classifiers to declare Linux and macOS support explicitly. Verified with the required guard check and `python3 -m pytest tests/scp_mcp/ -xvs` (11 passed).
